realLifeExampleSummary: Eine unsichere Person steigt in eine volle Bahn und glaubt, dass alle ihr Outfit bemerken, während die meisten Fahrgäste mit sich selbst beschäftigt sind.
coverVisualThesis: Eine nervöse Hauptfigur glaubt im Zug, dass alle sie beobachten, während die übrigen Fahrgäste sichtbar mit ihren eigenen Dingen beschäftigt sind.

scenes.speechSection: Warum fühlt es sich manchmal so an, als würden plötzlich alle auf dich schauen? Genau das nennt man Spotlight-Effekt.
scenes.visualIdea: one nervous passenger feels watched while everyone else is actually occupied with themselves
scenes.visualTask: Show a nervous central passenger believing the entire train is watching, while surrounding passengers visibly focus on phones, a book, the window or their own thoughts. Every visible person must use the same stylized stickman anatomy family.
scenes.lightingMood: warm interior light with cool evening windows and a subtle focal spotlight on the main character
scenes.titlePlacement: compact asymmetric integrated title block in reserved negative space, never a full-width top banner

scenes.speechSection: Dabei beobachten dich andere meistens viel weniger, als es sich für dich anfühlt.
scenes.visualIdea: felt attention is larger than actual attention
scenes.visualTask: Illustrate one large perceived spotlight versus several small scattered real attention directions; no human is required if the schema is clearer without one.

scenes.speechSection: Der Grund: Du erlebst dich selbst aus der ersten Reihe. Deine Kleidung, Fehler und Unsicherheit sind für dich ständig sichtbar.
scenes.visualIdea: the self is experienced at extreme visual proximity
scenes.visualTask: Show a symbolic first-person mirror composition where personal details loom large while the surrounding world remains softer and farther away.
scenes.lightingMood: soft warm mirror light with cooler background

scenes.speechSection: Stell dir vor, du steigst in eine volle Bahn und findest dein Outfit plötzlich peinlich.
scenes.visualIdea: a person enters a crowded train and becomes self-conscious about clothing
scenes.visualTask: Show a young stickman-inspired character stepping into a busy train, glancing down at their clothes with sudden embarrassment while every other passenger uses the same stickman family.
scenes.lightingMood: cool evening outside, warm carriage interior

scenes.speechSection: Sofort entsteht das Gefühl: Die anderen haben es bestimmt bemerkt.
scenes.visualIdea: self-consciousness makes surrounding faces feel directed toward the person
scenes.visualTask: Show the same character tense in the aisle while a few ordinary passenger glances feel exaggerated; all visible people remain the same simplified stickman family.
scenes.lightingMood: slightly intensified focal contrast around the main character

scenes.speechSection: Aber die meisten Fahrgäste denken gerade an ihr Handy, ihre Haltestelle oder ihre eigenen Sorgen.
scenes.visualIdea: other passengers are absorbed in their own concerns
scenes.visualTask: Contrast the anxious main character with surrounding passengers independently focused on a phone, route shapes, a book, the window and private thoughts; every person uses the same stickman family.
scenes.lightingMood: balanced warm train lighting with varied small focal pools

scenes.speechSection: Genau hier entsteht der Spotlight-Effekt: Deine eigene Aufmerksamkeit wird leicht mit der Aufmerksamkeit anderer verwechselt.
scenes.visualIdea: self-attention is mistaken for attention from others
scenes.visualTask: Create a cinematic illustrated schema comparing a strong inward self-attention beam with much weaker outward attention from other people; human figures are optional and may be omitted for clarity.
scenes.lightingMood: soft blue and amber dimensional lighting

scenes.speechSection: Ein kleiner Blick kann dann wirken, als hätte dich jemand genau beurteilt.
scenes.visualIdea: a brief neutral glance is interpreted as judgment
scenes.visualTask: Show one passenger briefly glancing toward the nervous character while the nervous character reacts as if strongly judged; both use the same stylized stickman anatomy family.
scenes.lightingMood: quiet carriage light with subtle tension

scenes.speechSection: Dabei kann die Person genauso gut einfach durch den Wagen geschaut haben.
scenes.visualIdea: the same glance has a neutral alternative explanation
scenes.visualTask: Show the exact same glance from a wider angle revealing the passenger is simply looking through the carriage; both people stay in the same stickman family.

scenes.speechSection: Besonders stark wird dieses Gefühl, wenn du nervös bist oder neu in einer Situation.
scenes.visualTask: Show a newcomer entering a small group setting while every visible person uses the same stickman-inspired anatomy family, individualized only through clothing/accessories/posture.
scenes.lightingMood: warm social room with cooler light around newcomer

scenes.speechSection: Dann suchst du schneller nach Zeichen dafür, dass andere dich bewerten.
scenes.visualIdea: attention selectively hunts for social evaluation signals
scenes.visualTask: Visualize a scanning beam selecting tiny facial-cue symbols from an otherwise calm social field; omit full human figures if the metaphor is clearer without them.
scenes.lightingMood: focused searching light against calm background

scenes.speechSection: Und genau dadurch wirken neutrale Blicke plötzlich bedeutungsvoller, als sie wirklich sind.
scenes.visualIdea: a neutral glance becomes inflated into supposed evidence
scenes.visualTask: Show a tiny neutral eye/glance symbol casting an oversized dramatic shadow that visually exaggerates its importance; no human needed.
scenes.lightingMood: controlled dramatic shadow inside the same 2D film-world

scenes.speechSection: Ein guter Gegentest ist einfach: Wie lange denkst du über kleine peinliche Momente anderer nach?
scenes.visualIdea: reflect on how little attention we give other people's minor mistakes
scenes.visualTask: Show a calm stickman-family character remembering a stranger's tiny awkward moment, with the memory already fading away almost immediately.

scenes.speechSection: Meistens nur Sekunden – wenn du sie überhaupt bemerkst.
scenes.visualIdea: other people's small mistakes vanish quickly from attention
scenes.visualTask: Show a tiny awkward-moment icon fading rapidly out of a soft pool of attention while everyday life continues; no person required.
scenes.lightingMood: light neutral fade with warm accents

scenes.speechSection: Dasselbe gilt häufig auch umgekehrt. Andere Menschen sind viel stärker mit sich selbst beschäftigt.
scenes.visualIdea: everyone experiences themselves as the center of their own attention
scenes.visualTask: Show several people each inside a personal attention bubble; every person belongs to the same stickman family and differs only through clothing/accessories/posture.
scenes.lightingMood: multiple soft personal light pools in one coherent scene

scenes.speechSection: Wenn du das nächste Mal glaubst, alle schauen: Vielleicht stehst du nur in deinem eigenen Spotlight.
scenes.visualIdea: the imagined giant spotlight shrinks into a personal self-attention light
scenes.visualTask: Show one large theatrical spotlight shrinking into a small calm personal light; use an environment/object-led closing illustration and omit people if clearer.
scenes.lightingMood: calm warm resolution with soft blue surroundings
